chunks: 1619 - Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abd al-Karim ibn Utbah al-Hashimi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to distribute the charity of the people of the desert among the people of the desert, and the charity of the people of settled towns among the people of settled towns. He did not divide it equally among them; rather, he distributed it according to the number of them present before him and as he saw fit. There was nothing fixed in that.

key_terms.الْحَضَرِ: the settled town or city dwellers
key_terms.صَدَقَةَ: charity, here referring to zakat funds being distributed
key_terms.مُوَقَّتٌ: fixed, predetermined, or set by a defined measure
key_terms.يَحْضُرُهُ: those who are present before him

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم distribute zakat between Bedouins and city dwellers?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Prophetic sunnah (prophetic tradition) in distributing zakat among local recipient groups, distinguishing between desert dwellers and town dwellers. It indicates that distribution was not necessarily equal, but was based on those present and the judgment of the authority handling it, without a rigid fixed measure.
